body.name: Orientation-specific threshold-cut polytope
body.construction: For \(o\in\mathcal O\), let \(Q_o(q,\delta_D,\delta_S)\) contain exactly the arrays \((d,u,v,r,s,(c_x)_x,(f_x)_x,(h_x)_x,(n_x)_x)\) satisfying \(\text{def:diagonal-residuals}\), \(\max\{0,U_x+V_x-c_x\}\le h_x\le\min\{U_x,V_x\}\), \(0\le n_x\le h_x\), \(n_x\ge h_x-B_{xk}\) for every \(k=-1,\ldots,K-1\), \(n_x\le G_{xk}\) for every \(k=0,\ldots,K\), \(\sum_x f_x\le\delta_D\), and \(\sum_x\{o_xU_x+(1-o_x)V_x-h_x\}\le\delta_S\sum_x c_x\). Prefix-sum recurrences for \(u\) and \(v\) give an equivalent rational extended formulation with \(O(mK)\) variables, constraints, and nonzero coefficients.
